conventions.canonicalization: Sorted JSON object keys; array order preserved; UTF-8; no whitespace
conventions.contentDigest: SHA-256 of object excluding contentDigest and assessmentRefs
conventions.captureDigest: SHA-256 of full capture excluding digest
conventions.sourceRevisionDigest: Capture digest, not Source object contentDigest
conventions.selector: UTF-16 start inclusive/end exclusive in captured post text; exact must match
conventions.vocabularies: Provisional pilot terms, not ratified; other languages/topics require a versioned change
